messages:
Evelyn: Hi team — I just got my final payout as a contractor and noticed federal tax withheld (line shows FIT $450). I thought 1099 contractors don't have federal withholding. Is this a mistake?
Raj (Finance): Contractors shouldn't have payroll tax withheld unless they were paid through payroll inadvertently. Did you get a W-2 or 1099 for the year?
Evelyn: I received a 1099-NEC email from vendor portal but the payment stub (PDF) attached to the portal shows "Federal Withholding $450" and net reduced.
Marta (Payroll): Thanks for the heads up. Occasionally a contractor record is accidentally flagged as a payroll payee for a single run and withholding applies. Can you upload the payment stub and your contractor onboarding form?
Evelyn: Uploaded stub and contractor agreement to case PR-2026-920. Stub filename: stub-12-28.pdf.
Raj (Finance): If payroll withheld by mistake we need to reclassify the payment, reimburse the withheld amount, and ensure the correct 1099 is issued without withholding. Also need to check if vendor taxes were reported.
Marta (Payroll): Action: I'll triage. If it's an accidental payroll run we will: 1) refund the withheld amount as a separate reimbursement check in the next run, 2) reissue the vendor payment record so the year-end 1099 reflects the gross amount, and 3) work with Accounting to reverse any payroll reporting.
PeopleOps Bot: Case PR-2026-920 created and assigned to team: contractor-payroll. Estimated SLA: 7 business days.
Evelyn: Thank you. Quick Q: will this affect my estimated taxes? I already paid quarterly based on gross.
Marta (Payroll): The reimbursement will restore your gross. We'll provide a statement you can use for your records and for your tax preparer. If you made an estimated payment that now looks different, that's between you and your tax advisor; we'll provide docs.
Raj (Finance): Note for ops: add a pre-flight check to the contractor payout workflow to ensure vendor records aren't flagged as payroll payees.
Marta (Payroll): Agreed — I'll add that to the KB and link it in the case. Leaving this open until refund processed. :thumbsup:
